thread:
Aria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's authz postmortem. We have three main remediation tracks: token validation & rotation, audit log enrichment/retention, and permission-drift detection. Need owners + rough ETAs. Who can pick what?
Devon: I can own token rotation. Plan: auto-rotate service tokens every 30d, add token validity check at auth-time, and write e2e for rollout. ETA: proposal by Mon 2025-09-08, implementation in ~2w after approval.
Priya: I'll take audit logs. Need to add request_id + caller_id to all auth checks, backfill missing events for last 90d, and bump retention to 365d for security logs. ETA: prototype next Thu. :mag:
Liam: Permission drift looks like a recurring issue from infra scripts. I'll add a daily snapshot job and a detector that alerts on >3 unexpected grants. ETA: spike this week, full rollout in 10 business days.
Aria: Great. Action items w/ acceptance criteria:
- Token rotation (owner: Devon) — CRs: rotation runs without 503s, can roll back in 1h, system tests pass. Tracker: SEC-1273.
- Audit enrichment (owner: Priya) — CRs: all auth events include request_id & principal, retention config applied, queries for incident forensics run <1s for 30d window.
- Perm-drift detection (owner: Liam) — CRs: daily snapshots stored, alert firing test, false-pos <10% for initial 2w.
Devon: Created ticket SEC-1273 and draft runbook in /docs/sec/token-rotation.md. snippet to trigger one-off rotation:
```
# one-off rotate service-token for svc-embed
redwoodctl secrets rotate --service svc-embed --confirm
```
Priya: I'll need infra support for backfilling logs — @Liam can you open a perm infra task for retention changes? Also need KMS collaboration for key-rotation cadence.
Liam: Yep, opening INFRA-88 for retention change. Also, putting up an RFC for monthly audit reviews to catch patterns. :calendar:
sec-bot: Ticket SEC-1273 created (owner: Devon). ETA fields set.
Aria: Next check-in: Fri 2025-09-12 @ 11:00am PT in #incidents. Please update your ticket with status before EOD Thu. If blockers appear ping me. :white_check_mark:
Devon: ack. Will post proposal by EOD Mon.
Priya: ack — will add the backfill plan and list of missing events.
Liam: ack — will push the spike PR today.
Aria: Thanks all — goal is to close the high-risk gaps before the next deploy window. Keep updates in the tickets and paste short status here before Fri.
